SCOTT CITY HERITAGE

The Heart of Our Kitchen

American diner warmth meets bold Mexican flavors in Scott City, Kansas. Hand-cut ribeyes, house-spiced chorizo, and breakfast served from sunrise to sunset.

KANSAS GRIND & FLAME

Where Honest Flavor Meets Family Tradition

Founded right inside Abarrotes La Favorita on East 5th Street, The Grill House KS was built on a simple promise: serve generous, unpretentious, homemade food that keeps locals coming back day after day.

From our hand-cut ribeye steaks seared to order on our flat-top grill, to our slow-cooked pork chorizo and 3-egg all-meat omelettes, every recipe reflects our passion for quality ingredients and warm Kansas hospitality.

Hand-Cut Meats Daily
